question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing left back, Bob is playing cheerleader, Claire is playing center midfielder, Dave is playing right back, Eve is playing right winger, Fred is playing benchwarmer, and Gertrude is playing sweeper.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Dave and Gertrude trade positions. Then, Eve and Alice trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Fred trade positions. Then, Bob and Eve trade positions. Then, Gertrude and Dave trade positions. Then, Claire and Eve trade positions. Finally, Fred and Gertrude trade positions. At the end of the match, Alice is playing
Options:
(A) left back
(B) cheerleader
(C) center midfielder
(D) right back
(E) right winger
(F) benchwarmer
(G) sweeper
solution:
Position order in every row: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve | Fred | Gertrude
Initial: left back | cheerleader | center midfielder | right back | right winger | benchwarmer | sweeper
1. Dave ↔ Gertrude: left back | cheerleader | center midfielder | sweeper | right winger | benchwarmer | right back
2. Eve ↔ Alice: right winger | cheerleader | center midfielder | sweeper | left back | benchwarmer | right back
3. Gertrude ↔ Fred: right winger | cheerleader | center midfielder | sweeper | left back | right back | benchwarmer
4. Bob ↔ Eve: right winger | left back | center midfielder | sweeper | cheerleader | right back | benchwarmer
5. Gertrude ↔ Dave: right winger | left back | center midfielder | benchwarmer | cheerleader | right back | sweeper
6. Claire ↔ Eve: right winger | left back | cheerleader | benchwarmer | center midfielder | right back | sweeper
7. Fred ↔ Gertrude: right winger | left back | cheerleader | benchwarmer | center midfielder | sweeper | right back
Alice is playing right winger, option (E).
Final answer: (E)
